sentences.text: The petitioners are merely seeking direction to the respondents to initiate acquisition process under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. Learned advocate for respondent nos.4 to 6 referring to the affidavits-in-replies and on instructions submits that already the process of acquisition has commenced, a notification under Section 11 (1) is about to be published and a joint measurement has taken place on 30.11.2022.
958-WP-3595-2020.odt 3.
In view of such state of affairs, it is expected that the acquisition process would be concluded within the statutory time limit.
Nothing survives in the writ petition and the same is disposed of.
